label: Starter, 50 km BEL cut, zero slip deficit at the Nankai and Japan Trench edges, UNR positions (exploratory MCMC)
description: starter_belcut50_unr with the slip deficit held at zero on the shallowest row of triangles of the Nankai and Japan Trench meshes in every window, so the trench edge creeps at the block-motion rate and has no afterslip (in the first year after Tohoku the tolerance is 1% of each window's 95th-percentile signal). It moves about 0.4 m of first-year afterslip out of the main rupture with no change in fit, but worsens the fit at the Suruga Trough, where stations are 20-35 km from the trench edge, and before Tohoku raises coupling farther downdip: new Noto mesh, UNR IGS20 positions, same 596 GEONET sites and windows
attribution: GNSS: GEONET daily positions, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI).
